questions.question:
A: Can you ______?
B: Yes, I can. I love music.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 'can' 後接原形動詞。根據 'love music' (喜愛音樂)，選項中只有 'dance' (跳舞) 為合理的動作動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 將動詞與名詞/形容詞混淆。

questions.question: He can ______ very fast. He is like a tiger!
questions.explanation: 形容動作很快且像老虎一樣，最適當的動詞是 'run' (跑)。

questions.question: My sister can ______ a beautiful bird.
questions.explanation: 針對 'beautiful bird' (美麗的小鳥)，最合理的才藝動詞是 'draw' (畫)。

questions.question:
______ you swim?
Yes, I can.
questions.explanation: 詢問能力（是否會某事），使用助動詞 'Can' 開頭，且回答也使用了 'can'。
questions.commonMisconception: 誤用 Do 或 Are 開頭。

questions.question: She ______ sing very well. Listen!
questions.explanation: 表示能力「會唱歌」，使用 'can'。且 can 後接原形動詞 'sing'。
questions.commonMisconception: 分不清 can 與 B 動詞用法。

questions.question:
A: Can your brother fly?
B: No, he ______. He is not a bird!
questions.explanation: 對於 'Can...?' 的否定回答為 'No, he can't' (cannot)。

questions.question: I can dance. ______ you?
questions.explanation: 詢問「那妳呢？」最常用的句型是 'How about you?'。

questions.question: Toby can ______ high. Look at him!
questions.explanation: 助動詞 'can' 後面固定接「原形動詞」。
questions.commonMisconception: 受第三人稱主詞影響誤加 s 或 ing。

questions.question: Ducks can swim, but they ______ fly high.
questions.explanation: 對比連結詞 'but' 表示前後意向相反。鴨子會游泳，「但不會」飛得很高。

questions.question:
Sam can run fast. May can sing. Ken can draw. 
Question: Who can make a beautiful song?
questions.explanation: 文中敘述 May 會唱歌 (can sing)，所以她能創作出好聽的歌曲。
questions.commonMisconception: 詞彙轉換（sing 與 song）的關聯理解。

questions.question:
Frogs can jump. Fish can swim. Birds can fly. 
Question: Which animal can move (移動) in the sky?
questions.explanation: 鳥類會飛 (fly)，是在天空中移動的動物。
questions.commonMisconception: 方位常識與英文動作連結落差。

questions.question:
A: Can you play the piano?
B: No, but I can play the guitar.
Question: What can B do?
questions.explanation: B 說不會彈鋼琴，但「會彈吉他」。
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略轉折詞 but 以後內容。

questions.question:
Mom: 'Can you help me cook?' 
Son: 'I can wash the rice, but I can't cook.' 
Question: Will the son help Mom?
questions.explanation: 兒子表示會幫忙洗米，即為一種幫忙的形式。
questions.commonMisconception: 局部肯定與整體肯定的邏輯判斷。

questions.question:
My robot can do many things. It can walk and talk. It cannot eat food.
Question: Can the robot eat a pizza?
questions.explanation: 文中明確說 'It cannot eat food'，披薩是食物，故不能吃。

questions.question:
A: ______ can swim well?
B: The blue fish can.
questions.explanation: 回答是 'The blue fish' (藍色的魚)，雖然魚是動物，但在擬人或詢問「誰」具備此能力時可用 'Who' 或 'Which one'。在此選項中 'Who' 是最接近詢問主體的選項（相較於 What/Where/How）。
questions.commonMisconception: 疑問詞選取受限於人類/非人類刻板印象。

questions.question: The water is deep. You ______ swim here. It is dangerous.
questions.explanation: 水很深且危險，所以「不能/不可以」在這裡游泳。

questions.question: Lily is a good singer. She ______ join the music club.
questions.explanation: 她是有才華的歌手，所以「能夠/可以」加入音樂社團。

questions.question: Spiders have eight legs. They can ______ very well.
questions.explanation: 蜘蛛有八條腿，最擅長的能力是爬行 (climb)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備詞彙 climb 的情境想像。
